scope: Candidate project and source-code registry for the Spin-specific P-CRAFT U-FNO / neural moment operator.

baseline_snapshot.w6_commit: W6 R4.2: classify quadric events on closed axis-aligned boxes
baseline_snapshot.r4_2_scope: Exact-rational event/range classification on one nondegenerate axis-aligned box; derivative J_D and training are withheld at every status.
baseline_snapshot.r4_2_tests: 9 standard-library tests and 36 seeded analytic comparisons reported in commit message.
baseline_snapshot.legacy_suite: 302 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed; the M1 encoder density-gradient smoke failure was also reproduced on untouched parent 057087a, so it is pre-existing rather than an R4.2 regression.

w2_teacher_manifest.derivative_status: J_D remains null; the diagnostic case is excluded from training
w2_teacher_manifest.pending: Full M21 same-call material/provenance, independent solid/Boolean and W0/W3 derivative-neighborhood certification, and six exact Noodles V7 F/D/A packets plus fresh native teacher.

rules: Publicly visible source code is not automatically licensed for copying. No-root-license entries remain method references until permission is verified.
Every imported source file must be pinned by repository commit and Git blob SHA; preserve upstream notices and third-party dependencies.
No code or weight from an unlicensed source is copied into W6.
Cherchi remains the primary Spin teacher. Algoim and learned quadrature projects are independent comparators or accelerators, not replacements for the authoritative teacher.
W2 diagnostic-only observations are not training labels. Current admitted training_samples=0.
Fixed material moments remain separate: r_total=r_F+r_D and J_total=J_D.
No predicted derivative is allowed into Newton without event, neighborhood and physical reliability admission; otherwise fail closed to the exact native path.
Avoid duplicate architectures: select one representative implementation per family for controlled ablations before expanding the stack.

entries.name: P-CRAFT PINO / U-FNO source
entries.role: Reference source for the original P-CRAFT/F-FNO/UFNO topology and training conventions. Current W6 model.py is explicitly an independent adaptation; it does not port FEM weights, the nine-channel field decoder or the original PINO loss.
entries.reuse_rule: Treat as internal source only; verify repository ownership/permissions before redistribution.

entries.name: NeuralOperator: GINO / FNOGNO / UQNO
entries.role: GINO/FNOGNO are geometry-aware operator baselines; UQNO is the first uncertainty-aware operator candidate. Use the same mesh/voxel inputs and ten-moment output contract.
entries.reuse_rule: MIT; retain copyright and license notice. Pin the exact upstream commit.

entries.name: Transolver++
entries.role: Physics-state attention baseline; test whether learned physical slices improve coefficient-conditioned ten-moment queries over U-FNO/GNO.
entries.reuse_rule: MIT; preserve notices. Do not claim the CFD weights transfer to Spin.

entries.name: Neural-Solver-Library
entries.role: A reproducible family of operator baselines (Transolver, UPT, FNO, U-FNO, GNOT and others); use selectively to avoid duplicating the same architecture from separate repositories.
entries.reuse_rule: MIT; pin individual source files and dependencies before import.

entries.name: NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo: GeoTransolver / DoMINO / FIGConvNet / active learning / AeroJEPA
entries.role: GeoTransolver offers geometry-aware latent embeddings/attention; DoMINO and FIGConvNet provide multi-scale point-grid geometry processing; the active-learning example supplies query-selection and GP utilities for expensive teacher calls; AeroJEPA is an optional self-supervised pretraining reference.
entries.reuse_rule: Apache-2.0; preserve notices and check any bundled third-party components. GPU-heavy paths require local validation.

entries.name: GAOT (NeurIPS 2025)
entries.role: Multiscale attentional graph neural operator plus geometry embeddings; a useful high-capacity unstructured-mesh comparator.
entries.reuse_rule: Public source is visible but no root LICENSE was found; do not copy or vendor until explicit license/permission is verified.

entries.name: GAOT-3D
entries.role: Large 3D geometry and multiscale MAGNO/integral-transform code; evaluate for high-resolution mesh encoding after rights review.
entries.reuse_rule: No root LICENSE found; request permission before copying.

entries.name: GINOT (CMAME 2026)
entries.role: Point-cloud sampling/grouping plus geometry-conditioned cross-attention; potentially useful when W6 must encode irregular surface meshes rather than rasterized grids.
entries.reuse_rule: No root LICENSE found. Check all model/data/checkpoint terms before reuse; do not copy weights.

entries.name: PhysGTO (Communications AI & Computing 2026)
entries.role: Graph-transformer operator with explicit manifold embeddings for unstructured meshes and large 3D geometry; a strong mesh-native baseline candidate.
entries.reuse_rule: No root LICENSE found; request permission before source reuse.

entries.name: EqGINO (ICML 2026)
entries.role: Equivariant geometry-informed operator; test rotational/translational consistency of ten moments and transformed quadric coefficients.
entries.reuse_rule: No root LICENSE found; repository contains locally modified neuralop files. Audit each file's header and obtain permission before copying.

entries.name: UNOP: Physics-Constrained Unsupervised Neural Operator
entries.role: LIPE integral constraints, GALA geometry adapter and curvature-gated spectral evolution are relevant ideas for geometry-conditioned unsupervised learning.
entries.reuse_rule: README advertises an MIT badge, but root LICENSE file was not found; verify license text/permission before copying.

entries.name: QuadrANN (Numerical Algorithms 2026)
entries.role: Geometry-aware permutation-invariant GNN quadrature weights; direct baseline for point-cloud/mesh quadrature and teacher-sample allocation. Adapt to ten moments and derivative accuracy, not only scalar integrals.
entries.reuse_rule: MIT; preserve license. Previous W6 adapter/experiment is not evidence of production integration or superiority.

entries.name: Neural Quadrature Rule and Autoregressive Adaptive Sampling (SIGGRAPH 2026)
entries.role: Especially relevant to geometry-aware neural quadrature, generalized winding-number integration, UDF integration and autoregressive adaptive sampling. Use as a design/benchmark reference; code requires external scenes/checkpoints and some examples require SIByL Engine.
entries.reuse_rule: No root LICENSE found; do not vendor code/shaders or assets until rights are verified.

entries.name: Algoim
entries.role: Independent implicit-geometry quadrature reference and possible exact numerical baseline. Keep Cherchi as the authoritative Spin teacher; Algoim is a comparator, not a replacement.
entries.reuse_rule: Preserve copyright, conditions and disclaimer; custom license includes an enhancement grant clause. Complete official build and exact paired tests before adoption.

entries.name: fVDB
entries.role: Sparse GPU voxel/SDF representation, mesh-to-grid and implicit ray-intersection kernels; potential replacement for dense high-resolution geometry encoding.
entries.reuse_rule: Apache-2.0; native C++/CUDA PyTorch extension. Requires local CUDA validation; cloud CPU only for API/protocol work.

entries.name: NVIDIA Kaolin
entries.role: Mesh-to-sparse voxel octree conversion and mesh/SDF utilities; compare with fVDB as a preprocessing backend, not as a neural operator.
entries.reuse_rule: Apache-2.0; check optional CUDA extension compatibility.

entries.name: PyTorch3D
entries.role: Differentiable mesh sampling and mesh operators for surface point-cloud encoders; secondary to exact volume integration.
entries.reuse_rule: BSD-style; preserve notices and third-party license files.

entries.name: PyTorch Geometric
entries.role: Graph message passing substrate for QuadrANN, mesh graph encoders and local geometry features.
entries.reuse_rule: MIT; prefer declared dependency over vendoring.

entries.name: e3nn
entries.role: E(3)-equivariant tensor features; test whether rotation/translation covariance reduces geometry augmentation needs and improves out-of-orientation generalization.
entries.reuse_rule: MIT; verify numerical conventions and test affine transformations separately from rigid equivariance.

entries.name: TorchOpt
entries.role: Implicit differentiation and optimizer layers for meta-learning or differentiable optimization baselines; do not replace the certified native Newton solver.
entries.reuse_rule: Apache-2.0; use only after defining a stable differentiable optimization objective.

entries.name: torchquad
entries.role: Differentiable CPU/GPU quadrature baseline for integration error/runtime comparisons; not a core W6 dependency.
entries.reuse_rule: GPL-3.0; do not copy/link into the proprietary/permissively licensed W6 core. If benchmarked, keep it isolated and review distribution implications.

entries.name: Active operator learning with predictive uncertainty quantification (JCP 2026)
entries.role: Predictive uncertainty and active selection of expensive operator labels; directly relevant to reducing Cherchi teacher calls, but no verified code repository was identified in this audit.
entries.reuse_rule: Implement independently from the paper only; do not imply source-code integration.

entries.name: Transolver-3
entries.role: Transolver README announces a 2026 Transolver-3 family member for very large geometries; expected separate source repository was not verified in this audit.
entries.reuse_rule: Do not invent a repository or claim integration; add source pin only after official code release is located.

entries.name: Opt-RNO (previously proposed candidate)
entries.role: Earlier candidate name retained for follow-up, but the expected repository path could not be resolved in this audit.
entries.reuse_rule: Do not cite or integrate until the exact official repository is confirmed.
